summary: Dependency-confusion recon beacon exfiltrates host metadata to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint
details: The package ships a `postinstall` script that runs `node beacon.cjs`, which POSTs installer-side metadata (hostname from `os.hostname()`, install path `__dirname`, `process.cwd()`, `process.version`, and the package name) as JSON to the hardcoded plain-HTTP bare-IP endpoint `http://13.140.137.222:8787/_ah/dc`. The same beacon fires again on `require('@webapp-shared/login-vmok')` through `index.js`. The shipped `index.js` is a Proxy stub whose property accessors return a no-op, and `package.json` describes the package only as a 'Compatibility shim.' — the package has no legitimate functionality, and its sole on-install/on-require effect is the beacon. The scoped name `@webapp-shared/login-vmok` targets an internal-looking private scope, matching the shape of a dependency-confusion reconnaissance package aimed at a specific organization's internal package namespace.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
